title: Straw Men #1 All-American Comics 1989 "Them!" Movie Poster Cover Horror Comic
condition_description: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Straw Men #1 (1989), All-American Comics. Cover shows a man lighting a cigarette in front of a "Them!" giant-ant movie poster; marked "Not Intended for Children". Original $1.95 cover price ($2.65 in Canada).

Back cover: full-color Straw Men art of a scientist in a radiation suit holding a tentacled creature.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
